excluded.detail: Actor and checkpoint binaries are not redistributed without a separate written basis.
Repository redistribution is not granted; the sources are cited by reviewed commit instead.
Hostnames, usernames, local absolute paths, and machine records are removed from every published artifact.
The written permission covers sanitised samples and aggregates only; complete raw datasets are not redistributed.
Third-party SUMO assets carry their own rights and are not republished under the owner permission.
excluded.identifier: third-party SUMO network and FCD assets

included.description: Accepted and unavailable VEC-09 _s102 aggregate metric states.
Three-row pseudonymised and rounded matched task-trip _s102 sample.

limitations: Pseudonymisation reduces direct identification but is not anonymity.
Rounded sample rows are illustrative and must not be used to reproduce exact values.
Deadline success is not eventual physical task completion.
Eligible targets are not transfer confirmation or execution targets.
Owner permission is not a formal software or data licence; public hosting is not authorised.

permission.basis: Written source-owner response received for the TrafficTwin dissertation.
permission.licence_statement: Owner permission covers sanitised samples and aggregate outputs only and is not a formal software or data licence.
permission.scope: Sanitised samples and aggregate outputs in this repository and dissertation.

sanitisation.statement: Three source-matched rows use sequential pseudonyms, remove source identity and clock fields, round numeric values, and retain only declared schema and units.

publication_policy.selected_seed_disclosure: The _s102 rows and aggregates are a disclosed best-of-seeds selection, not an average over evaluator seeds.

value_minimisation: source vehicle IDs, slots, task indices, trace times, full-day times, and targets removed
